City of Encinitas
Youth Commission
AGENDA
SEPTEMBER 4, 2019 -
04:30 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS - None
5.
COMMISSIONER’S OATH OF OFFICE
5A.
Conducted by Commission Secretary Melody Colombo.
5B.
Introduction of Parks, Recreation and Cultural Arts Department Staff – Recreation Services Manager – Travis Karlen, Recreation Supervisor – Christian Hernandez, and Management Analyst – Melody Colombo.
6.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES) Each speaker has three (3) minutes to address the Youth Commission. There are no time donations during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the Clerk. Direction to staff to bring back a future agenda item or provide additional information to answer a question requires consent of at least two Commission Members.
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA - Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
APPROVAL OF THE JUNE 5, 2019 YOUTH COMMISSION REGULAR MEETING MINUTES
8A.
Approve the June 5, 2019 Youth Commission regular meeting minutes.
2019-06-05 YC Minutes
9.
APPROVAL OF THE AUGUST 21, 2019 YOUTH COMMISSION ORIENTATION WORKSHOP
9A.
Approve the August 21, 2019 Youth Commission Orientation Workshop minutes.
2019-08-21 YC Workshop Minutes
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Youth Commission Chair and Vice-Chair
The Youth Commission by ballot elects the FY2019-20 Chair and Vice Chair to serve a one-year term.
2019.09.04 Item 10A Agenda Report Chair and Vice Chair
10B.
FY 2019-20 Youth Commission Proposed Work Plan
The Youth Commission will review a list of potential work plan initiatives and begin work on the plan and assignment of Youth Commission representatives (maximum of (3) commissioners per initiative)
2019.09.04 Item 10B Draft Work Plan Initiatives
10C.
FY 2019-20 Youth Commission Meeting Calendar
The Youth Commission adopts the proposed FY 2019-20 Youth Commission meeting calendar.
2019.09.04 Item 10C FY 2019-20 Meeting Calendar
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Department updates – Manager Karlen
11B.
2019 Commission Member Resource Handbook - Supervisor Hernandez
11C.
2019-20 City Events calendar - Supervisor Hernandez
12.
COMMISSION MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - Commissioner prepared and presented agenda items.
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COMMISSION MEMBERS - Commissioners may add future agenda items with consensus of two or more Commissioners.
14.
COMMISSION REPORTS - Roundtable: All Commissioners
ADJOURNMENT
